description: US commercial real estate listings from Showcase for a city, for lease or for sale: listing ID, title, property type (office, retail, industrial, flex, coworking...), asking rent or price text as shown (e.g. $19.00-$21.00 USD/SF/yr, or rent withheld), address, size range in square feet and number of spaces, and listing URL; 30 per page plus the number of matching listings (Showcase caps it at 500). Optional property-type filter on the page. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City as in Showcase URLs, e.g. dallas, los-angeles (required)

type.description: Optional words of the property type, e.g. office, retail, industrial

name: realestate_showcase_commercial
title: Realestate Showcase Commercial
